notes:
Overview:
- Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + user insights). Building conversational insights and semantic search into product UI + nightly enrichment pipeline. Evaluating Redwood as primary embedding generator + semantic search stack.

Decision context / priority:
- Priority: improve QA search relevancy for customers, reduce nightly embed job time, and contain per-embedding cost.
- Current stack: in-house embedding runner (self-hosted), pgvector on managed Postgres for neighbor search; spikes in cost and long jobs during nightly reindex (200k docs).
- Looking to start with Hosted API for quick integration and later move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost. POC -> Dedicated pilot -> annual commit.

POC scope (what we agreed in demo):
- Demo 2026-01-18: api walkthrough + vector DB connectors (showed Pinecone + pgvector adapters).
- POC start 2026-02-01: 2-week hosted POC, embed up to 20k docs/day, measure latency and error rates.
- Extended POC: full nightly batch (200k docs) run on hosted infra to benchmark time-to-complete and token cost. SE to provide batching recommendations.

Key requirements / metrics from product team:
- Embedding throughput: target 200k docs per nightly job; ideal job run < 3 hours, acceptable < 6 hours.
- Real-time query latency: 95th percentile < 150ms for vector neighborhood + rerank in UI.
- Cost target for embeddings: ~$0.00015 - $0.00025 per vector (very price sensitive).
- Model preference: small/fast embeddings model for batch + higher-dim for rerank experiments; want option to pin versions and fallback models.
- Vector DB: must integrate with pgvector (primary) but open to managed vector DBs for dedicated.
- Operational: audit logs, retention controls, KMS for keys, SSO/SAML, IP allowlist.

POC results summary (hosted tests):
- Sample run (2026-02-10): 25k docs batched @ 512B avg text -> hosted embedding throughput ~3.2k docs/min with current default batch size; extrapolated nightly run ~1.05 days without optimizations.
- With SE tuning (increased batch size + concurrent workers) reachable ~9k docs/min simulated -> projected nightly run ~4.5 hours. Need to validate on dedicated.
- Search latency test (small index + rerank): cold 95p ~210ms; warm 95p ~120ms. Rerank adds ~40ms.
- Error profile: transient 429s during burst; Redwood suggested autoscale and burst capacity for Dedicated.

Commercial notes / pricing conversations:
- Initial ask: hosted POC credits and pricing sheet for both hosted and dedicated. Sales provided worksheet (see Drive link).
- Cost sensitivity: finance asks for committed ARR bands and unit rates. They want breakeven vs current infra within 9 months.
- SE recommended Optimize settings: adaptive batching, cache suggestions, and quantization guidance for dedicated GPUs.

Security & legal:
- Legal submitted security questionnaire 2026-02-22. Need SOC2 attestation and DPA with EU data residency clause.
- Dataflow: embeddings may include PII (user feedback). Must support selective retention and audit logs.

Stakeholders and owner notes:
- Champion: Head of Product (Anna Ruiz) - cares about UX latency and relevance. Quote: "Search needs to feel instantaneous for our customers."
- CTO (Jason Lee) focused on cost and migration path to dedicated.
- AE / Owner: Ethan Green - primary contact for commercial.
- SE: Maya Chen - POC architect (running benchmarks).
- Legal & Security: Claire Montoya - running SOC2/DPA review.

Timeline / next actions:
- 2026-03-12: follow-up call to review extended nightly benchmark results (scheduled).
- Action: SE to run dedicated-simulated benchmark using Redwood recommended batch sizes and provide a config spec + cost estimate. (Maya)
- Legal: send DPA + sample residency clause to PetalBridge by 2026-03-18.
- Sales: produce dedicated trial pricing / commitment tiers and ARR scenarios.

Open questions / blockers (shorthand):
- Can Redwood guarantee EU-only residency for embeddings and logs?
- Will dedicated trial include burst capacity for production-like query spikes?
- Exact per-embedding pricing at scale (200k nightly + 3M queries/month).

Misc links & artifacts:
- Fireflies: ff-20260218-0012 (POC kickoff), ff-20260125-0897 (initial intro)
- Drive: pricing worksheet + POC run logs (see links above)
- Jira: REDW-1127 (429 spikes investigation), REDW-1184 (billing worksheet)
